sections.Profile:
"Sea Breeze," released by North Star Coin Machine Company in 1949, is a single-player, electro-mechanical pinball machine featuring a maritime theme. The game was developed by brothers Gerard and Jacques Tremblay in Montreal, Canada.

- Manufacturer: North Star Coin Machine Company
- Years made: 1949
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Women, Wood Rail, Ocean, Original Theme, Beach
